title: For each school that has at least one department named "Political Science"
question: For each school that has at least one department named "Political Science" or "Mathematics", what is the name of the school, the variance of the CIP program code for all degree-granting Mathematics courses with a non-null department name, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for all courses offered by departments in that school, excluding any courses from the Chemistry department? Present the school name, the variance of the CIP program code, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Political Science', 'Mathematics')
),
cip_variance AS (
    SELECT
        sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
        VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_variance
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
      AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
      AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM eligible_schools)
    GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME
),
units_cv AS (
    SELECT
        sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
        STDDEV(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS units_cv
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM eligible_schools)
      AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'
    GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME
)
SELECT
    es.SCHOOL_NAME,
    cv.cip_variance,
    uc.units_cv
FROM eligible_schools es
LEFT JOIN cip_variance cv ON es.SCHOOL_NAME = cv.SCHOOL_NAME
LEFT JOIN units_cv uc ON es.SCHOOL_NAME = uc.SCHOOL_NAME

GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY) SELECT cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte1.subject_count, cte1.min_total_units, cte1.school_name, cte1.department_phone, cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte2.area_stddev, cte2.DLC_NAME FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.dlc_key = cte2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte2.area_stddev WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.avg_cip_program_code, dcs.range_cip_program_code, dcs.var_cip_program_code, ph.HGN_CODE, ph.max_lecture_units, ph.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS range_cip_program_code, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS var_cip_program_code FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dcs JOIN (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_ID HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2) AS ph ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ph.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_cip_program_code, inner_cte.range_cip_program_code, inner_cte.var_cip_program_code, inner_cte.HGN_CODE, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON so.SUBJECT_TITLE = inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HGN_CODE

WITH enrolled_variance_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_students_variance > (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), material_count_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, evc.enrolled_students_variance, mcc.highest_material_count_for_status FROM enrolled_variance_cte AS evc LEFT JOIN material_count_cte AS mcc ON evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY evc.enrolled_students_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE), cte1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP), DepartmentSubjects AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, grade_type, subject_count, min_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.DLC_KEY FROM cte1 AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), DepartmentRoomStats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, o2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte2.area_stddev DESC) SELECT ds.department, ds.grade_type, ds.subject_count, ds.min_total_units, ds.school_name, ds.department_phone, drs.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS organization_name, drs.area_stddev, drs.DLC_NAME AS dlc_name FROM DepartmentSubjects AS ds JOIN DepartmentRoomStats AS drs ON ds.DLC_KEY = drs.DLC_KEY ORDER BY ds.department, ds.grade_type, drs.area_stddev DESC

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), rollup_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM rollup_cte ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT subq1.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, subq1.TIP_TERM_CODE, subq1.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte1 AS (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte1 WHERE coefficient_of_variation > 0.2), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY) SELECT cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.coefficient_of_variation, cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte2.area_stddev, cte2.DLC_NAME FROM cte1 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON sd.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN cte2 ON fo.DLC_KEY = cte2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY cte1.coefficient_of_variation DESC, cte2.area_stddev DESC

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH political_science_subjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), department_units_stats AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME), department_school_phone AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.geometric_mean_students, ps.total_students, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsp.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dsp.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM political_science_subjects GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0) AS ps LEFT JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON ps.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE LEFT JOIN department_units_stats AS dus ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN department_school_phone AS dsp ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsp.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dsp.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME

icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, ss.avg_subject_codes_per_department, mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.COURSE_LEVEL, mcs.course_count, GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY) SELECT cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte1.subject_count, cte1.min_total_units, cte1.school_name, cte1.department_phone, cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte2.area_stddev, cte2.DLC_NAME FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.dlc_key = cte2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte2.area_stddev WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Political Science', 'Mathematics')
),
cip_variance AS (
    SELECT
        sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
        VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_variance
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
      AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
      AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM eligible_schools)
    GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME
),
units_cv AS (
    SELECT
        sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
        STDDEV(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS units_cv
    FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM eligible_schools)
      AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'
    GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME
)
SELECT
    es.SCHOOL_NAME,
    cv.cip_variance,
    uc.units_cv
FROM eligible_schools es
LEFT JOIN cip_variance cv ON es.SCHOOL_NAME = cv.SCHOOL_NAME
LEFT JOIN units_cv uc ON es.SCHOOL_NAME = uc.SCHOOL_NAME
